question.text: A modulating signal <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>2</mn><mi>sin</mi><mfenced><mrow><mn>6</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>28</mn><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mn>6</mn></msup></mrow></mfenced><mi>t</mi></math> is added to the carrier signal <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>4</mn><mi>sin</mi><mfenced><mrow><mn>12</mn><mo>.</mo><mn>56</mn><mo>×</mo><msup><mn>10</mn><mn>9</mn></msup></mrow></mfenced><mi>t</mi></math> for amplitude modulation. The combined signal is passed through a non-linear square law device. The output is then passed through a band pass filter. The bandwidth of the output signal of band pass filter will be _____ <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>MHz</mi></math>.

solution.text:
Frequencies present in output of square law device

2fc,  fc+fm,  fc,  fc-fm,  2fm,  fm

After passing through band pass filter, frequencies present 

fc+fm,  fc,  fc-fm

Bandwidth of the output signal =2fm

=2ωm2π=6.28×1063.14 =2 MHz
